about: Named seams we are removing: a second implementation of one thing. Each count must go to zero over the nights. scripts/measure.py reads this file. An exclude entry with a slash is a path from the repo root; one without a slash names a file or a folder on the way. "suffixes" narrows the file types (default: every text type the script reads).

seams.name: Two step-dot implementations (wizard and walk)
seams.why: The New program wizard and The Walk each draw their own step dots; one step-dot part serves both.

seams.name: ProgramRefused definitions
seams.why: One refusal class for Programs, defined once in program_definitions.py.

seams.name: _create_app lines in web_server.py
seams.why: web_server.py still builds the app beside the web package's own factory.

seams.name: Keystore readers outside keystore.py
seams.why: Every secret goes through keystore.py; a direct keyring call is a second reader (and a second Keychain prompt).

seams.name: Refusal classes outside the definitions homes
seams.why: #1894 made program_definitions.py and project_definitions.py the homes of the words; a Refused class in another service is a second home.

seams.name: "Hand to agent" face strings
seams.why: #1884/#1886 replaced the second hand-off verb with Run as program; the old words must not come back on a face or in user docs.

seams.name: toUpperCase( in web/src/desk/needs
seams.why: The lamp guard's rule: Needs you casing comes from the type scale, not from code that shouts.

seams.name: Viewport max-width media outside the container-query allowlist
seams.why: UX-CANON §D: a window body stacks under its surface container, never viewport media; the allowlist is the shell list in web/src/desk/__tests__/containerQueryLaw.test.ts.
